_comment: Roofed and lightless. `ambient_light` is the nether's 0.1 rather than the flat 0.0 an unroofed lightless Age gets: a world shut overhead is lit by its own rock and lava, where an open one with no sun is a void and should be black. It names NO fog, sky or ambient colour: in 26.1 a biome carries its own, and naming them pinned the nether's fog to one dull colour for every biome and multiplied its glow down to nothing (Jonah, 2026-08-14, walked, twice). A zero-alpha cloud colour stays, being the only way to skip the cloud pass at all.
